title: Critique: full-body illusions may be partial illusions

statements.text: Adrian Alsmith argues that the classical studies of full-body illusions have not excluded that they induce only a partial identification with the avatar, limited to the body parts stimulated. Whether full-body illusions exist is empirically underdetermined, so they may not manipulate a global self-representation.

sources.quote: putative full-body illusions are difficult to isolate from illusions involving composite parts
